title: Navigating Changing Dynamics & Relationships with Kahran and Prem & Andrew, co-founders of Humanly
summary: Kahran sits with Prem and Andrew, co-founders of Humanly (an HR-tech company helping mid-market companies source and screen candidates) just after they announced acquiring Teamable/Top Funnel. They walk through how they make big decisions as cofounders, how the role of each founder has to keep evolving as the business goes from 0-to-1 to 100-to-1000, and what it takes to stay aligned through disagreements, fights, and acquisitions.
topics: scaling roles as the business grows

intents.display: to hear cofounders talk about staying aligned through fights and acquisitions
to think about how a founder's role has to evolve as the company grows
